title: Principal Software Engineer
jobDescription:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world. This Position reports to: Lead Technology Product Manager What we believe in ABB’s Process Automation business area enables customers to operate some of the world’s largest and most complex industrial infrastructures, helping them outrun – leaner and cleaner. We offer a broad range of automation, electrification and digital solutions for process, hybrid and maritime industries, including industry-specific integrated control and software as well as measurement and analytics solutions and services. Your role and responsibilities In this role, we are looking for an experienced Principal Software Engineer – Full Stack to join our Industrial Automation Digital Organization. The role requires a strong technical leader with extensive experience in React or Angular, .NET, and modern software architecture to design and deliver scalable industrial software platforms. You will lead the architecture and development of cloud-native, high-performance applications that integrate Information Technology (IT) and Operational Technology (OT) systems while driving engineering excellence across the software development lifecycle. You will also champion AI-assisted software engineering practices by enabling development teams to leverage LLM-powered coding assistants and AI agents to accelerate software delivery, testing, and architectural decision-making. The work model for the role is: Hybrid You will be mainly accountable for: Lead the architecture, design, and development of scalable full-stack applications using React/Angular, .NET, microservices, and cloud-native technologies while ensuring high performance, maintainability, and software quality. Drive engineering excellence by defining software architecture standards, mentoring development teams, promoting best practices, and leading adoption of modern software development methodologies including AI-assisted engineering workflows. Design and deliver secure, reliable, and highly available industrial software solutions by integrating enterprise applications with automation platforms, real-time communication protocols, REST APIs, Web Sockets, and modern cloud technologies. Collaborate with architects, product managers, and cross-functional engineering teams to deliver complex software solutions, reduce technical debt, improve system performance, and ensure predictable delivery of high-quality releases. Qualifications for the

ROLE:
12+ years of experience in Full Stack Software Development with strong expertise in .NET (C#), ASP.NET Core, React or Angular, and enterprise-scale application development. Proven experience designing scalable microservices architectures, RESTful APIs, distributed systems, and cloud-native applications using modern software engineering principles. Strong knowledge of SQL Server, Postgre SQL or No SQL databases along with backend frameworks, ORM technologies, and frontend state management concepts. Experience with Azure or AWS cloud platforms, CI/CD pipelines, containerization technologies (Docker, Kubernetes/K3s), Dev Ops practices, and software security standards. Good understanding of industrial automation technologies such as OPC UA, MQTT, SCADA, MES, Io T platforms, and integration between Operational Technology (OT) and Information Technology (IT) systems is preferred. Demonstrated technical leadership with experience mentoring engineers, defining engineering standards, driving architectural decisions, and successfully delivering complex enterprise software solutions across cross-functional teams. BE/BTech/ME/MTech in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics, or related engineering disciplines with excellent communication skills and passion for innovation, continuous learning, and AI-driven software engineering practices. More about us ABB is a leading global technology company that energizes the transformation of society and industry to achieve a more productive, sustainable future. The Process Automation (PA) business area automates, electrifies and digitalizes some of the world's most complex industrial infrastructures. Through its five divisions, it serves customers across energy, process, hybrid and maritime industries by delivering innovative automation, digitalization and industrial software solutions that enable safer, smarter and more sustainable operations. Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences. Ready to make an impact? The Division also supports the development, integration and scaling up of new and renewable energy models. The Division’s goal is to help customers adapt and succeed in the rapidly changing global energy transition.
